memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: This is how the lampstand was made: It was made of hammered gold—from its base to its blossoms. The lampstand was made exactly like the pattern the Lord had shown Moses. - Num 8:4 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The lampstand was a work of great beauty — hammered from pure gold, shaped with blossoms and delicate detail, from its base to its top. And it was made "exactly like the pattern the Lord had shown Moses." Nothing was left to human imagination; it followed God's design precisely.

Two things shine out here. First, God cares about beauty. The lampstand was not a plain, functional object; it was crafted with artistry and care, gold hammered into the form of living blossoms. Our God is a God of beauty as well as truth, and He delights in things made well and lovingly.

Second, it was made exactly according to God's pattern. The craftsmen did not improve on God's design or add their own ideas. They followed His plan faithfully, down to the details. There is wisdom in this. When it comes to the things of God — how we worship, how we live, how we serve — we are not called to invent our own way, but to follow the pattern He has given us in His Word.

The lampstand, made of gold and giving light, also whispers of Christ, who is the true Light and whose glory outshines all. And in Revelation, the churches themselves are pictured as lampstands, holding up the light of Christ in a dark world (Rev 1:20).

Let your life be shaped carefully according to God's pattern, made beautiful by His hand, holding up the light of Christ.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you follow God's pattern, or prefer to invent your own way?
- How does it encourage you that God values beauty and care?
- How can your life "hold up" the light of Christ?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, shape my life according to Your pattern, not my own ideas. Make me a vessel that holds up the beautiful light of Christ in this dark world. Amen.
